summary: feat(settings): require localized page titles in AppLayout
description:
Because:
- Most settings pages left the tab title as "Mozilla accounts", failing WCAG 2.4.2
- VoiceOver reads the " | " title separator aloud as "vertical line"

This commit:
- Makes AppLayout's title required except while loading; every page passes one
- Gives multi-state pages a title per state or step
- Lets a CMS page title take precedence over the page's own title
- Uses an en dash separator under a new FTL ID, app-page-title-3
- Stops FlowContainer setting a second Head inside AppLayout

Closes #FXA-6803
